landing.faq1Q: Is Velbok only for tattoo studios?
landing.faq1A: Velbok is built for tattoo and piercing studios with consent workflows, multi-artist scheduling, and deposit handling — but any appointment-based creative studio can use the core platform.
landing.faq2Q: Do my clients need an account?
landing.faq2A: Clients can receive links for deposits and consent without a full account. Optional customer accounts unlock the portal for bookings, enquiry tickets, and invoices.
landing.faq3Q: Can I use my own branding?
landing.faq3A: Yes. Each studio deployment supports custom shop name, colours, contact details, and portal theming.
landing.faq4A: Velbok runs on Supabase (PostgreSQL) with row-level security. Each studio instance is isolated — your data stays yours.

general.title: Who we are
general.p1: {{shopLegalName}} (trading as {{platformName}}) operates the Velbok platform at velbok.com and the Velbok mobile apps. We are the data controller for studio account data, platform billing, and our own operations. Tattoo studios using Velbok are separate controllers for their clients' booking, consent, and CRM data.

roles.title: Platform vs studio responsibilities
roles.p1: When you register a studio on Velbok, we process your business contact details, subscription billing, and staff accounts as controller. When your studio enters client bookings, consent forms, messages, or invoices, you are the controller and Velbok acts as processor on your instructions.
roles.p2: Studios must provide their own client-facing privacy information for in-studio services (including any CCTV at physical premises). This notice covers the Velbok software and website.

dataCollect.title: Data we collect
dataCollect.p1: Depending on your role and interaction, we may collect: name, email, phone, business address, account credentials, booking and invoice records, messages, uploaded images (references, avatars, signatures), payment metadata, cookie/device data, and — where studios use digital consent — health information required for tattoo or piercing safety.
dataCollect.p2: Card numbers are entered directly into Stripe (online checkout, invoices, and in-person Terminal / Tap to Pay). Velbok does not store full card numbers on our servers.

healthData.title: Health and consent data
healthData.p1: Digital consent forms may collect medical history answers (for example allergies, heart conditions, pregnancy, or blood thinners) and a drawn signature. This is special category data under UK/EU GDPR. Studios collect it with explicit consent from the client for safety, legal, medical, and insurance purposes.
healthData.p2: Velbok stores consent responses and generated PDFs securely on behalf of the studio. Retention follows the studio's professional and insurance requirements, typically several years.

whenCollect.title: When we collect data
whenCollect.p1: We collect data when you create an account, subscribe to Velbok, configure a studio, manage bookings or billing, complete consent forms, use in-app messaging, contact support, or use payment features on web or mobile.

mobile.title: Mobile app (Android / iOS)
mobile.p1: The Velbok app may request device permissions to support in-person payments: precise location and Bluetooth (card readers and Stripe Tap to Pay), and NFC for contactless Tap to Pay. Location is required by payment regulations and fraud prevention — it is not used to track you for advertising.
mobile.p2: The native app does not show the web cookie banner; we use strictly necessary local storage for sign-in and preferences only. Optional marketing/analytics cookies apply on the website only.

subprocessors.title: Service providers (sub-processors)
subprocessors.p1: We use trusted providers to run Velbok, including: Supabase (authentication, database, file storage, edge functions), Stripe (payments, Connect payouts, Terminal / Tap to Pay), Resend (transactional email), Twilio (optional WhatsApp/SMS per studio), and Netlify (website hosting). Each provider processes data under contract and their own privacy terms.
subprocessors.p2: We do not sell personal data. We share data only where necessary to provide the service, comply with law, or prevent fraud.

transfers.title: International transfers
transfers.p1: Some providers may process data outside the UK/EEA (for example the United States). Where required, we rely on appropriate safeguards such as Standard Contractual Clauses and provider compliance programmes.

lawfulBases.title: Lawful bases (UK GDPR / EU GDPR)
lawfulBases.p1: We rely on consent, contractual necessity, legal obligation, and legitimate interests depending on context.
lawfulBases.consentDesc: optional cookies on the website, marketing opt-ins, and explicit consent for health data in studio consent forms.
lawfulBases.contractDesc: providing the Velbok service, studio subscriptions, bookings, deposits, and invoices.
lawfulBases.legalDesc: tax, accounting, and lawful requests from authorities.
lawfulBases.legitimateDesc: security, fraud prevention, product improvement, and service communications.
lawfulBases.vitalDesc: protecting life or health in an emergency.

howUse.title: How and why we use data
howUse.p1: We use personal data to operate Velbok, authenticate users, process studio subscriptions and client payments, deliver notifications, support studios, improve reliability, and meet legal obligations.
howUse.p2: {{shopLegalName}} does not sell personal data to third parties for their own marketing.

cookies.title: Cookies and similar technologies
cookies.p1: Our website uses cookies and local storage for sign-in, security, language preferences, and optional analytics/marketing categories when you consent. See our Cookie Policy for details.
cookies.p2: Transactional emails may include tracking pixels to measure delivery and engagement.

security.title: Security and retention
security.p1: We use encryption in transit (HTTPS/TLS), access controls, and industry-standard hosting. No internet transmission is entirely risk-free.
security.p2: We retain account and transaction records as long as needed for the service, legal obligations, and dispute resolution — typically at least five years for business records, and longer where insurance or consent documentation requires.

children.p1: Velbok is studio management and booking software — we do not perform tattoo or piercing services. Minimum ages for those services are set by each studio and the law where they operate (including piercings for minors with a parent or guardian, where permitted).
children.p2: Studio administrator and staff accounts are business accounts and are not directed at children under 13. When a studio records a booking or consent form for a minor client, the studio is the data controller and must obtain any required parental or guardian consent.
